name: Vásárosfalu (Hungary)
description: White field with curved bands of red, blue and green sweeping from the lower hoist to the upper fly, the red filling the upper fly and the green the lower hoist, charged in the upper hoist with the municipal arms of Vásárosfalu (a red shield with a white bird crest and a scroll).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vásárosfalu arms with crest and scroll
